chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Hammad, from 'Imran al-Halabi, who said:
I said: A man doubts while he is standing, and does not know whether he has performed ruku' or not. He said: Then let him perform ruku'.
ai.seo_question: What should someone do in salat (prayer) if he doubts, while standing, whether he has performed ruku'?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt during salat (prayer). If a person is still standing and becomes unsure whether he has performed ruku', he should proceed to perform the ruku'.
